title: 165 Loh Kung Lieh 1930 chairman of stock exchange

page_data.en:
Form No. 3
G. 32,000-1-30

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. C 168
Central Station,
REPORT
Date ____ 1. 10. 1930

Subject (in full) D.C. C753's remarks on attached report.

Made by __ D.D. Mason. __ Forwarded by ____________________

Sir
I beg to report that an examination of
CDC 153's diary shows no entry of any visits made by him.
There are two entries relating to the
Gold Exchange and Mr Yee You Suen.
On September 1st 1930 DS Brownin and
CDC 153 took a number of opium bars to Mr Yee's shop.
These were found on the person of a gold dealer who
dropped dead on the Bund. They were handed over to the
instructions of the Prosecutor who held the inquest.
The other entry relates to a visit to the
Gold Exchange on September 15th re enquiries regarding
an applicant for a bodyguard's pistol licence.
Enquiries show that the CDC is on very
friendly terms with Mr Yee and that the CDC
calls on Mr Yee and discusses private and family
affairs. Both families are on friendly terms.
I am, Sir
DC. (C 753)           Yours faithfully
DDO A. Brownin.          Mason D.D.
To _________________

事由（全称） D.C. C753 对附件报告的评语。

制作人 __ D.D. Mason. __ 转呈人 ___

先生：
谨此报告，经查阅
CDC 153 的日记，未见其有任何拜访记录。
其中有两项记录涉及
金业交易所及 Yee You Suen 先生。
1930年9月1日，警探长 Brownin 和
CDC 153 将数根鸦片烟签送至 Yee 先生的店铺。
这些烟签是在一名死于外滩的金商身上搜出的。它们已移交给
主持验尸审讯的检察官处理。
另一项记录涉及9月15日前往
金业交易所，就一名申请保镖持枪许可证的事宜进行查询。
调查显示，该华籍侦探长（CDC）与 Yee 先生
关系非常友好，且该华籍侦探长
常拜访 Yee 先生，并商讨私人及家庭
事务。两家人关系和睦。
此致
敬礼
DC. (C 753)           您忠实的
DDO A. Brownin.          Mason D.D.
致 ___

Sir

Re the attached I beg to report that
enquiries show that C.D.C. 153 Roh Kung Dien is
on very friendly terms with Mr Zee Hoh Sun the
Chairman of the Exchange.
It appears that when Mr Zee requires the
services of the Police he invariably sends for
this Detective.
Three private Detectives, or Detective's
seconds, are employed at the Exchange and
it may possibly be that their jealousy has been
aroused.

I am Sir
Your Obediently
Mason D. J.

调查显示，华籍侦探长（C.D.C.）153号 Roh Kung Dien（音译）
与交易所主席 Zee Hoh Sun 先生

看来，每当 Zee 先生需要警方
